_help: Bow (c_resaresa) on her PM64 sprite rows: her TTYD model is the body (posed as the sprite moves: the bob, the leans, the arms, turned away for PreSlap); her face (eyes, brows, lashes, mouth, Spook's jaw, the googly eyes) is the sprite's own pixels per frame, cut from each raster, and the fan its own raster. Every raster is read from the player's ROM at runtime. Notes: local-docs/poses/bow.md.

F0.pm64: WorldBow anim 0 (Still): Neutral held. Port: pm64_partner_pc.c (Party tab / still)

F1.pm64: WorldBow anim 1 (Idle): Neutral riding the bob component (y 0,1,3,2,0,-1,-3,-2 px, held 8/6 frames). Port: kAnims field A_IDLE/A_JUMP/A_FALL

F2.pm64: WorldBow anim 2 (Walk): Step1 4, Step2 2, TailDown 4, Step2 2 on the bob. Port: kAnims field A_WALK and A_MOVE (Outta Sight)

F3.pm64: WorldBow anim 3 (Run): Step1, Step2, TailDown, Step2, 2 frames each, on the bob. Port: kAnims field A_RUN

F4.pm64: WorldBow anim 4 (Talk): Talk1 2, Talk2 4, Talk1 2, Neutral 4 on the bob. Port: kAnims field A_TALK

F5.pm64: WorldBow anim 5: Read (holding a letter) held

F7.pm64: WorldBow anim 7 (spook start): Conceal 8, Spook1 4, then Spook2 held

F8.pm64: WorldBow anim 8 (spook loop): Spook2 4, Spook3 2, Spook4 6, Spook3 2

F10.pm64: WorldBow anim 10 (celebrate, fan): Celebrate1/2 6 each, fan FanAcrossBody1/2 at (8,1), arm and patch paint-overs

F11.pm64: WorldBow anim 11 (celebrate, fan): Celebrate3/4 6 each with the fan. Port: kAnims field A_GLAD

F12.pm64: WorldBow anim 12 (Flail): Flail1 6, Flail2 6. Port: kAnims field A_HURT
